root_cause: Provider-observation UI accepted a PASS/VERIFIED row with evidence_available even if observed_at or expires_at was absent, expired, future-dated, or validity was unbounded. The database snapshot only changed expired non-null dates to STALE, so missing expiry could remain falsely verified.

prevention.rule: Every provider control requires independent source evidence, observed_at, non-null expires_at, observed time not older than 24h, observed time no more than 5m in the future, expires_at not later than 24h after observation, and expires_at in the future; only then can the portal mark that control verified.
prevention.writer: original exclusive protected ONE BRAIN writer only
